member.name: T:AspNetCore.Simple.Sdk.Swagger.EnumSchemaFilter
member.summary:
A schema filter that removes, in the generated Json, the numeric member values from the s definitions and and replaces them with the member names. However, the data type of the referencing parameters and properties remains numeric (usually ).
As a consequence, names instead of numbers will be used in the client code generators' IntelliSense and validations.

member.name: T:AspNetCore.Simple.Sdk.Swagger.ExtensibleEnumFilter
member.summary:
A schema-and-parameter filter that replaces, in the generated Json, each -based definition with a -based definition plus "x-extensible-enum" list (a list of the enum member names.)
As a consequence, names instead of numbers will be used in the client code generators' IntelliSense and validations. Unlike , when the C# enum's members grow, this will not signify a breaking change for consuming clients.
See also guideline #112 by Zalando, who invented this mechanism.
